title: Urology and Continence Supply Program: restocking basis for returned HMO straight-tip boxes
content:
When the warehouse accepts unopened straight-tip intermittent catheters (A4351) returned on a Continence Commercial HMO Program of the Urology and Continence Supply Program, the restocking basis depends on how many boxes of 30 the accepted units fill.

## Fulfilment terms

| Accepted units on the return receipts for the returned refill | Restocking basis |
|---|---|
| at least 30 but fewer than 60, which fills at least one box but fewer than two | replaced by one box's worth, that is, 30 units times the price |
| fewer than 30, which fills less than one box | replaced by nothing |
| 60 or more, which fills two or more boxes | stays the gross credit |

## Boundaries (hypothetical)

- 59 accepted units: one box's worth. 60 accepted units: the gross credit.
- 30 accepted units: one box's worth. 29 accepted units: nothing.
